source_locator: Page 1 resolution RES 13-1798, MAYOR (4 Year Term) table; abstract page 1 of 39, Mayor First Choice
verification_note: St. Paul elects its mayor by ranked choice voting. The council canvass resolution RES 13-1798, passed November 13, 2013, lists Chris Coleman 23875, Tim Holden 4978, Kurt Dornfeld 547 and Sharon Anderson 917. Coleman had a majority of the first choice votes (23875 of 30518 including 201 write-ins), so no reallocation was needed and the first choice count is the final round. Totals match the abstract and the county summary report.

verification_note: St. Paul elects its mayor by ranked choice voting. The abstract first choice counts are Melvin Carter 31353, Pat Harris 15281, Dai Thao 7590 and others, 61646 in total. source_locator: Council resolution RES 25-1746, MAYOR (3 Year Term) table and Mayor Reallocation Results
verification_note: St. Paul elects its mayor by ranked choice voting. Council resolution RES 25-1746, passed November 12, 2025, lists first choice votes Carter 27611, Her 25884, Chen 6522, Hilborn 5815, Dullinger 1619 and write-ins 166. No candidate reached the threshold. The Mayor Reallocation Results give the final round totals used here: Kaohly Her 32295 and Melvin Carter 30418. The resolution declares Her elected. The signed abstract of votes cast, generated November 6, 2025, shows lower first choice counts (Carter 27261, Her 25658) than the council canvass. The council canvass figures are used because only they include the final round.
